current_concerns.primary_problems: Preoccupation with food and eating in daily life; restricting food intake and counting calories since approximately age 18; ongoing concern about body shape; avoids eating with others. Weight has partially returned over the past year.
current_concerns.goals: Be able to eat a meal with friends without planning for it several days in advance; reduce preoccupation with food so that the entire day does not revolve around eating.
